summary: A 16 by 16 light-grid sequencer modelled on Yamaha's TENORI-ON, with its six play modes. The FM-1 has no touch grid, so one marked row or column of the grid is played from the 16 white keys.
features: 16 layers and 16 blocks, each layer with its own loop length and speed
Modes: SCORE, RANDOM, DRAW, BOUNCE, PUSH and SOLO
28 synthesized sounds and 4 drum kits, no samples
MIDI in and out with one channel per layer

headings: gridlight — séquenceur à grille lumineuse pour m-vave fm-1
